development_build: 22Oct2023 exists but is not the K01 release baseline
reason: Use the stable Windows build for reproducible K01 release calculations. The official distribution supports Lua command-line automation and also includes/links Python interfaces.
automation_baseline: FEMM native Lua command line: femm.exe -lua-script=<script.lua> -windowhide
python_policy: pyFEMM is optional later. It is not required for the first MEDTAS FEMM adapter because the current workstation has already shown Python launcher/path instability.
release_model_rule: Final force extraction shall use the weighted stress tensor volume integral, with mesh/sensitivity and bench comparison recorded.
